benchmark: Region has no NZ benchmark places; Kangaroo Island's headline draws (Flinders Chase, Remarkable Rocks, Admirals Arch, Seal Bay, Vivonne Bay, Little Sahara, Kelly Hill Caves, Cape du Couedic, Cape Willoughby) are all placed. Kangaroo Island Wildlife Park (82011 views) kept.
destination_shape: One named island destination; no standalone spot within 40 km of its centre because there are none standalone. Flinders Chase kept as a spot so it is not an overlapping park destination.
note: All kept spots are inside the single destination; 0-view entries are thin-source second-tier beaches and walks the judge kept on a counted tourism-board/agency source.
